value.name: Marylin greets Miles at the door
value.description: Marylin welcomes Miles as he arrives at the house.
evidence: Marylin greets him at the door.

value.name: Marylin reveals surprise redecorating
value.description: Marylin tells Miles she has a surprise and brings him inside to see the newly accessorized house.
evidence:
MARYLIN
I have a surprise for you.

The place has been massively
accessorized. Antiques, rugs, lamps and assorted tasteful
chatchkies. There is a new Biedermeyer couch in the den.

value.name: Miles reacts coldly to the redesign
value.description: Miles stares at the redecorated room without expression, signaling immediate disapproval.
evidence: He stares at her -- a very dark look.

value.name: Marylin fears Miles rejects her
value.description: Marylin interprets Miles's reaction as personal rejection and asks whether he dislikes her.

value.name: Miles professes love with shocking intensity
value.description: Miles abruptly says he loves Marylin and wants to have her baby, despite his dark mood.
evidence:
MILES
(Flatly)
I love you. I want to have your baby.

value.name: Marylin worries she overspent
value.description: Marylin assumes the problem is the cost of the redecorating and offers to return everything.
evidence:
MARYLIN
What's wrong Miles? Did I spend too
much?
She retrieves all the receipts from her purse.

MARYLIN
Miles. I have a very good relationship
with all the salesmen. I can return
everything.

value.name: Miles laments lost trust and dreams
value.description: Miles bitterly says Marylin cannot return the trust, hopes, and dreams that have been damaged.
evidence:
MILES
Can you Marylin? Can you return the
trust? Can you return the hopes? The
dreams? Can you just...

(Bitterly)
SEND IT ALL BACK FOR STORE CREDIT?

value.name: Marylin becomes frightened by Miles's tone
value.description: Marylin tells Miles he is scaring her as his bitterness escalates.

value.name: Miles regains composure and praises the decor
value.description: Miles pulls himself together, reverses course, and reassures Marylin by calling the room chic, timeless, elegant, eclectic, and uniquely her.
evidence:
MILES
(Pulls himself together)
I'm sorry, Darling. I love it. It's
chic and timeless and elegant and
eclectic and. It's you, Marylin. It
is YOU.
